bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=29b243129b44f9b3f922c304479dc114e0830151
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
test "$(git remote get-url origin | sed 's#\.git$##')" = "https://github.com/seigo-gace/create-videobot" || exit 62
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 63
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
mkdir -p "$target"
git archive "$src" | tar -x -C "$target"
grep -q '規約・約款に同意済み' "$target/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs" || exit 64
docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" -t create-videobot:creator-$src "$target" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sh create-videobot:creator-$src -c 'grep -q "ved_video_" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs || grep -q "openOwnedVideo" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs; command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null' || exit 66
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
pass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
pin="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/var/lib/videobot/sticker-entry"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$pass" && test -d "$pin" || exit 67
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 68
usr="$(docker exec "$pg" printenv POSTGRES_USER)"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test -n "$usr" && test "$net" = deploy_default || exit 69
test -z "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' | grep -Fxv "$n" || true)" || exit 70
shop="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' "$n" | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL=//p' | head -n 1)"
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$pass" VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$pin" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$usr" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net" VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL="$shop"
compose="$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 71
docker image tag create-videobot:local-poll create-videobot:creator-rollback
docker image tag create-videobot:creator-$src create-videobot:local-poll
if ! docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 docker image tag create-videobot:creator-rollback create-videobot:local-poll
 docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 exit 72
fi
sleep 10
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" != true || ! docker logs --tail 100 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$'; then
 docker image tag create-videobot:creator-rollback create-videobot:local-poll
 docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 exit 73
fi
docker exec "$n" sh -c 'grep -q "openOwnedVideo" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs && grep -q "規約・約款" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs' || exit 74
echo VIDEO_CREATOR_UI_LIVE=PASS
